test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Train A running at a speed of 99 km/hr takes 46 seconds to completely cross train B running at 72 km/hr in the opposite direction. The length of train B is 1.5 times the length of train A. Train B crosses a bridge completely in 82 seconds. The length of the bridge (in m) is:
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

**Relative Speed** = 99 + 72 = 171 km/hr = 171 × (5/18) = 47.5 m/s.

Total Length (A + B) = 47.5 × 46 = 2185 m.

Length Ratio A : B = 1 : 1.5 = 2 : 3 ⇒ 5 units = 2185 m ⇒ 1 unit = 437 m.

Length of **Train B** = 3 × 437 = 1311 m.

Speed of B = 72 × (5/18) = 20 m/s. Bridge Crossing: 20 × 82 = 1640 m.

**Bridge Length** = 1640 − 1311 = 329 m.

**∴ The correct answer is 329 m.**

**__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4cbf7f478e2406e50ae9a27e6499b01873833e83b2897e9137733cb0bdaa2e46.png] 

**Given:** Speed A = 99 km/hr, Speed B = 72 km/hr, Time = 46 s, Length B = 1.5 × Length A.

**Formula Used:** Distance = Speed × Time; Relative Speed (Opposite) = S₁ + S₂.

⇒ Relative Speed = (99 + 72) × (5/18) = 171 × (5/18) = 47.5 m/s.

⇒ Total Distance = LA + LB = 47.5 × 46 = 2185 m.

⇒ Since LB = 1.5 LA, then LA + 1.5 LA = 2185 ⇒ 2.5 LA = 2185.

⇒ LA = 2185 ÷ 2.5 = 874 m.

⇒ LB = 1.5 × 874 = 1311 m.

⇒ Speed of Train B in m/s = 72 × (5/18) = 20 m/s.

⇒ Distance covered in 82 s = Speed B × Time = 20 × 82 = 1640 m.

⇒ Bridge Length = Total Distance − LB = 1640 − 1311 = 329 m.

**∴ The correct answer is 329 m.**

**__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed Concepts

When moving in the **opposite direction**, speeds are added (S₁ + S₂). In the **same direction**, speeds are subtracted (|S₁ − S₂|).

Crossing Distance

When a train crosses another train or a bridge, the **total distance** covered is the sum of their lengths (L₁ + L₂).

Unit Conversion

To convert **km/hr to m/s**, multiply by 5/18. To convert **m/s to km/hr**, multiply by 18/5.</p
